an4.237:1.1: cattārimāni bhikkhave kammāni mayā sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā paveditāni.
an4.237:1.6: atthi bhikkhave kammaṃ akaṇhaṃ asukkaṃ akaṇhaasukkavipākaṃ kammakkhayāya saṃvattati.
an4.237:2.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco sabyāpajjhaṃ kāyasaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti …pe… idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave kammaṃ kaṇhaṃ kaṇhavipākaṃ.
an4.237:3.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco abyāpajjhaṃ kāyasaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti, …pe… idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave kammaṃ sukkaṃ sukkavipākaṃ.
an4.237:4.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco sabyāpajjhampi abyāpajjhampi kāyasaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti, …pe… idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave kammaṃ kaṇhasukkaṃ kaṇhasukkavipākaṃ.
an4.237:5.1: katamañca bhikkhave kammaṃ akaṇhaṃ asukkaṃ akaṇhaasukkavipākaṃ kammakkhayāya saṃvattati?
an4.237:5.3: idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave kammaṃ akaṇhaṃ asukkaṃ akaṇhaasukkavipākaṃ kammakkhayāya saṃvattati.
an4.237:5.4: imāni kho bhikkhave cattāri kammāni mayā sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā paveditānīti.
